## What changed

Describe the problem and the proposed solution.

## Validation

- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`
- [ ] `uv run pytest -q`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Relevant browser or packaging checks

## Images and privacy

- [ ] No private microscope images, personal data, credentials, or generated build output are included.
- [ ] New sample images have a documented source and compatible license.

## Checklist

- [ ] The PR targets `development` unless it is a maintainer release PR.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and limitations are documented.
- [ ] Detection changes include deterministic regression coverage.
